name: json_string
description:
Builds a JSON object string from one or more key/value pairs. Keys must be strings. Numbers
and booleans are rendered as JSON primitives, all other values are rendered as JSON strings.
A multi-valued value is rendered as a JSON array and a null value as JSON `null`.

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the first key/value pair.

params.name: value
params.description: The value of the first pair, followed by any further alternating keys and values. Provide arguments as alternating key/value pairs.
